tool: REA 6.8.0 browser scenario capture (Chromium 155, Playwright driver)

pixel_parity.method: Headless Chromium screenshots at 1440x1200 with --force-prefers-reduced-motion; ImageMagick compare -metric AE

checks.name: mobile navigation
checks.observed: The header menu opens with aria-expanded=true and exposes the overflow links plus theme, language, and TTS tools. At 390x844 all links are reachable in a scrollable 44px-target panel.

checks.name: theme menu
checks.observed: The menu opens with role=menu; selecting Dark sets <html data-theme="dark"> and writes localStorage.theme=dark. The dark token set renders across the page.

checks.name: figure carousel
checks.observed: Clicking .fig-next changes the caption to "Plate 2 of 3. The first AI-native course: your agent teaches it, quizzes you, and tracks your path." and swaps the active SVG plate. Autoplay, dots, and reduced-motion pausing remain wired.

checks.name: ask the machine
checks.observed: Clicking the trigger sets data-state=answered, data-check=1, and renders the reply "Define ‘here’." with hint "In the meantime, build something." The label changes to Ask again.

checks.name: phase modal
checks.observed: Clicking Phase 00 opens #modalOverlay.open with title "Setup & Tooling", 13 lessons, a search field, per-lesson mark-done buttons, and a reset control. Escape/overlay/close and focus trapping are present.

checks.name: copy button
checks.observed: Clicking #installCopy changes #installCopyLabel to "copied" and sets the copied class; the state reverts after 1.5 seconds. Clipboard API failure falls back to execCommand.

checks.name: command palette
checks.observed: Opening from .search-toggle produces #cmdPalette.cp-open with aria-hidden=false, a focused combobox (#cpInput), a listbox (#cpResults), and the summary "Search 542 lessons, 13 focused learning paths, 526 outputs, and 250 glossary terms." Cmd/Ctrl+K is also bound.

console.text: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (File not found)
console.cause: The command palette imports /pagefind/pagefind.js on focus. Pagefind output is not included in the landing-only clone. The in-memory lesson/phase/path/glossary search still works.

notes: The clone was served with python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1.
The original screenshot was captured from https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/ on 2026-11-10 with the same viewport and reduced-motion flag.
Animation-heavy figure plates can pause at arbitrary frames in headless Chromium because hover/pointer capabilities differ; reduced motion makes the comparison deterministic.
